messages:
Matt R: hey team — need a very short sudo window (15m) to apply a hotfix on prod ingestion indexer. seeing ~10% 5xxs for legacy events, can't reproduce in staging. the fix is a DDL + small targeted update and a restart of the deployment.
Sanjay K: what's the absolute minimum perms you need?
Matt R: kubectl exec into indexer pod (read/exec only), ability to restart the indexer deployment, and psql superuser for one ALTER TABLE + targeted UPDATE/VACUUM. no exports, no dumps.
Jen (sec): pls open a ticket with justification & rollback plan, and include why staging didn't catch this. we need session recording, a 15m max window, and a named shadow. also no data exports allowed.
Matt R: created RW-4477: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4477 — description + rollback. proposing 23:00-23:15 UTC tonight. exact commands i'll run (run-in-k8s, no dumps):
```
kubectl -n prod exec deploy/indexer -- /bin/bash -c "psql -c \"ALTER TABLE ingestion_events ADD COLUMN tmp_processed boolean DEFAULT false;\""
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/indexer
```
security-bot: Approval checklist: ticket-present, owner-present, duration<=30m, session-recording enabled. Missing: explicit SQL text in thread, and named shadow. Creating lift-tag RW-ELEV-3092.
Maria L: i'm available to shadow, can join for the window.
Jen (sec): conditional approve — requirements: 1) paste exact SQL you'll run here before executing, 2) enable session recording, 3) add Maria to the sudo/session, 4) rotate any creds used after. tagging Alex for restart signoff.
Alex (oncall): ok to restart; i'll monitor metrics and can rollback. approve RW-ELEV-3092 for 15 minutes starting 23:00 UTC. :white_check_mark: 
Matt R: thanks — pasting SQL now. i'll NOT export any rows.
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE ingestion_events ADD COLUMN tmp_processed boolean DEFAULT false;
UPDATE ingestion_events SET tmp_processed = true WHERE event_type = 'legacy' AND processed = false LIMIT 1;
COMMIT;
```
Sanjay K: heads up — UPDATE ... LIMIT doesn't work in Postgres. suggest using ctid approach or WITH-subquery. running whole-table update could be unsafe.
Matt R: good catch. switching to a bounded ctid update:
```
WITH to_fix AS (
  SELECT ctid FROM ingestion_events WHERE event_type='legacy' AND processed=false LIMIT 1000
)
UPDATE ingestion_events SET tmp_processed = true WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM to_fix);
```
Jen (sec): copied. i'll add the approval in the lift system and enable session recording now. RW-ELEV-3092 approved by Jen (sec). make sure Maria is in the session and paste a short redacted post-run log in this thread.
Matt R: will do. starting at 23:00 UTC, will post start and end timestamps, and a redacted success snippet. no exports. thx.
Alex (oncall): after restart pls run quick smoke: `curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/health` and check 5xx rate for 5 mins. i'll watch dashboards.
Matt R: noted.
security-bot: Session recording enabled. RW-ELEV-3092 active.
Matt R: (will follow up with the post-action summary here) :thumbsup:
